prereg_status: PRE_REGISTERED_BEFORE_COMPUTE (arms, signal path, draws, decision rules unchanged)
purpose: Disclose the exact semantics of realized-funding application before any C25 cell runs, so the C25 report cannot overstate the funding model.
prereg_wording: cost_taker_funding = cost_taker + realized 8h funding series on every leg

implemented_model.name: VENUE_MEAN_SCALAR_FROM_REALIZED_HISTORY
implemented_model.description: Per venue, the engine receives one scalar funding_rate_pct_per_hour equal to the equal-weight mean of per-symbol mean realized 8h rates over the full 2023-01-01..2026-09-28 window, divided by 8 and by 100, and applies it uniformly over every held hour on every leg, with the engine's existing long-pays/short-receives convention.
implemented_model.not_implemented: A per-trade, per-symbol, per-timestamp realized 8h funding series lookup.
implemented_model.consequence: Within-venue time variation and symbol-level dispersion of funding are not modeled; only the venue-level realized mean replaces the flat 0.01 %/hr proxy.

binding_reporting_requirement: The C25 verdict and consolidated report MUST state funding_model=VENUE_MEAN_SCALAR_FROM_REALIZED_HISTORY and cite this file. They MUST NOT claim a per-trade realized funding series was applied. Per-trade funding-series application is deferred to C26 (intrabar path + per-trade funding fidelity) or a later explicitly pre-registered campaign.
integrity_note: This disclosure is additive metadata written before any C25 cell runs. It does not alter the preregistered arms, signal path, draw floors (20k/20k/2k) or decision rules.
